reason: A command-line pre-install gate that materializes and statically reviews npm, Git, and local DSH plugin sources, including archive, manifest, path, fingerprint, and optional policy checks.

summaries.zh: 在安装 DSH 插件前，对 npm、Git 或本地插件源进行物化、静态检查并输出结构化门禁结果。
summaries.en: A pre-install command-line gate that materializes and statically reviews npm, Git, or local DSH plugin sources before installation.

capabilities: Reads and snapshots local plugin sources
Fetches npm and Git plugin sources over HTTPS
Runs npm, Git, and Claude CLI subprocesses
Parses archives and validates paths and manifests
Computes content and tarball SHA-256 fingerprints
Returns structured gate findings and policy results
